title: wiki-sync state file
description: Durable cursor for the @wiki-sync detector agent (see issues #143, #144, #145). Records the last commit SHA whose wiki/** delta was fully resolved (filed / deferred / cancelled) so the next run only inspects newer commits.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Tooling-only; @wiki-sync does not require it.

lastProcessedSha.description: Full 40-char SHA of the most recent commit on main whose wiki/** delta was fully resolved by @wiki-sync. The next run computes the diff lastProcessedSha..HEAD.

lastRunAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (suffix Z) of when @wiki-sync last finished a batch.

lastBatchSummary.description: Outcome of the most recent batch. Each array holds issue/PR numbers or short identifiers; empty arrays are valid (e.g. seed entry).

filed.description: Items the agent successfully handed off (e.g. to @request-intake or @board-planner) and that produced a tracked issue or board item.

deferred.description: Items the agent flagged but chose not to file this run (e.g. waiting on a parent issue, or below threshold).

cancelled.description: Items the agent or operator explicitly dismissed during this batch (won't be re-detected unless reverted).

_seed.description: Optional metadata about the initial seed entry. Removed or overwritten on the first real @wiki-sync run.
